deploybot: ALERT: prod-inference canary healthcheck failed (elevated p95) at 2026-05-11T09:12:25Z. Auto-rollback suppressed due to release pin. Hotfix ready: redwood/inference:2026-05-11-hfA. Requesting expedited unpin and 15m change window. @maya @dmitri please ack.

maya: can you paste the error snippet?

deploybot: probe sample:
`WARN runtime.kv-cache: eviction spike -> p95 jump; stack: runtime/serve:kv_get`

dmitri: that matches the recent quant tuning. hotfix is a conservative revert + ttl increase. validated in staging (smoke x5).

nora: infra check: nodes show short CPU spike at deploy time, no IO pressure, no other rolling jobs.

maya: PM (nora) to update release notes and customer alert if we unpin?

nora: yes, i'll update changelog and ping impacted partners. image pinned in notes: redwood/inference:2026-05-11-hfA.

dmitri: roll plan: lift pin -> canary 10% for 8m -> ramp to 100% if p95 <= baseline*1.25 and errors < 0.5%. rollback otherwise.

maya: require deploybot guardrail flags and freeze new deploys during window.

deploybot: queued: `/deploy --image redwood/inference:2026-05-11-hfA --scope canary --ramp 10% --observe 480s --auto-rollback "p95>+25% || errors>0.5%" --override-pin release-lead-maya --freeze-deploys --audit "unpin-hfA"`

dmitri: +approve (eng lead). maya, you?

maya: +approve (release lead, expedite).

deploybot: APPROVALS RECEIVED. Lifting pin and starting canary. Will post updates every 2m.

deploybot: 09:15 UTC - canary 10% started.

deploybot: 09:23 UTC - telemetry: p95=110ms (baseline 90ms), errors 0.04%. within thresholds.

dmitri: proceed to ramp to 100% over 7m.

deploybot: 09:31 UTC - rollout complete. pin removed, audit note saved under run-id 20260511-ab12.

nora: changelog updated and customer notices sent. unfreeze complete.

maya: closing thread. follow-up: postmortem to capture quant rollout lessons. :white_check_mark:
